Package
Description
NetStrategies.CacheStrategies
Cache eviction strategies used by cache-equipped stations to decide which cached item is removed when the cache is full.
NodeSections
Node sections, the building blocks from which the JSIM simulation engine stations are composed.

    Subclasses of CacheStrategy in NetStrategies.CacheStrategies
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    FIFOCache
    FIFO (First In First Out) cache eviction strategy: removes the item that first joined the cached item list.
    class 
    HLRUCache
    h-LRU cache eviction strategy, the hybrid variant of LRU used for cached items.
    class 
    LFUCache
    LFU (Least Frequently Used) cache eviction strategy: removes the item with the smallest number of accesses.
    class 
    LIFOCache
    LIFO (Last In First Out) cache eviction strategy: removes the item that last joined the cached item list.
    class 
    LRUCache
    LRU (Least Recently Used) cache eviction strategy: removes the item with the smallest timestamp of last access.
    class 
    MRUCache
    MRU (Most Recently Used) cache eviction strategy: discards the most recently used items first.
    class 
    PLRUCache
    PLRU (Pseudo Least Recently Used) cache eviction strategy: approximates LRU behaviour at a lower implementation cost.
    class 
    RandomCache
    Random cache eviction strategy: removes a uniformly chosen item from the cached item list.
    class 
    TTLCache
    TTL (Time To Live) cache eviction strategy: removes items whose lifetime has expired.
